candidates.statement: Order service postgres.save_order fails with DependencyUnavailable while the connection pool reports size=5 and idle=0 across all three correlated checkouts, so save_order blocks ~2s and times out; gateway then returns 502 on /v1/checkout. Pool exhaustion at the order->postgres dependency is the bounded root cause.
candidates.uncertainty: Order logs/metrics were excluded from context; pool size=5/idle=0 is from traces only and could reflect a slow query rather than true exhaustion.

report.explanation: All three correlated checkout traces show inventory and payment succeeding, then postgres.save_order failing with DependencyUnavailable (pool size=5, idle=0) after ~2s, causing order 503 and gateway 502. This bounds the fault to the order->postgres dependency, consistent with db-pool-exhaustion. Order-side logs/metrics were excluded, so confidence is moderate.
